description.zh:
需要查询的防火墙规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量查询，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以通过[DescribeFirewallRules](~~212573~~)接口查看目标集群下所有防火墙规则的详情，包括规则名称。
description.en:
The names of the firewall rules to query. To query multiple rules, separate the rule names with commas (,).

> Call the [DescribeFirewallRules](~~212573~~) operation to view the details of all firewall rules for the target cluster, including the rule names.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-firewall-rules --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --rule-name-list testrule --region cn-hangzhou
